name: warehouse-inventory-system
description: E-Commerce Multi-Warehouse Inventory & Location Tracking System

scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.migrate:prod: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
